theme: A clear calendar, but a loaded travel weekend begins
greeting: Your last full day on the Croatia charter, Dan — the calendar's empty, but Saturday's disembark and Sunday's flight home leave real logistics still open.

needsAttention.title: St Pete nights, Sept 20–21
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA Sunday afternoon but the kids aren't picked up until Tuesday — the two nights before Orlando are still unbooked (p1 in Todoist).

needsAttention.title: TPA rental car, Sept 20–Oct 5
needsAttention.detail: Flagged 'book it outright' — a full-size SUV for the whole span, so you're not facing walk-up rates jet-lagged on a Sunday. Overdue in Todoist.

needsAttention.title: Cavtat disembarkation
needsAttention.detail: Charter ends ~noon Saturday at Komolac; the transfer to Cavtat, hotel bag hold, and a pre-dawn Sunday checkout for the 7:30 flight were all meant to be arranged from dry land.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: Portland's hardest holiday rental to find; the note says book it refundable this week before inventory thins. Overdue since Sept 14.

needsAttention.title: St Pete Airbnb charge
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 27–Oct 5 stay ($2,331) was pending host confirmation and bills today — worth checking it converted rather than expired.

schedule.title: Open on the calendar
schedule.detail: Last full day aboard the charter

flagged.title: Garmin new-location sign-in
flagged.detail: Garmin asked you to verify a sign-in from a new location (Sep 16) — likely just you abroad, but worth a look. Revolut also sent an email-verification request.

flagged.title: New Revolut account + charter payment
flagged.detail: Revolut came back verified with a card on the way, and $366.63 went out to Mladen Franic — all consistent with the Croatia trip.

flagged.title: Executive-search connection request
flagged.detail: A global partner at an executive-search firm sent a LinkedIn invite; the rest of the job mail was auto-alerts (Westinghouse VP Gov Relations) and the ICGN Toronto conference push.

inbox.noise: Otherwise all newsletters and promos — Noahpinion, NYT Cooking, St. Pete Local, Italian Word of the Day, plus airline and loan offers.
inbox.clear: No personal email is awaiting your reply.

resolved: Cavtat hotel locked in — Remisens Epidaurus, sea-view family room with breakfast, for tomorrow night.
Autopay cleared this week: Amex, AT&T, and Central Maine Power all processed.
Revolut account verified and card ordered ahead of the trip.

recipe.title: Pumpkin chiffon pie
recipe.why: A pointer for when you're back in your own kitchen — the first real edge of autumn is here, and this airy, lighter take on pumpkin pie is the perfect excuse to fire up the oven as the evenings cool.

tasks.title: Disney tickets for the six of you (Sept 26–27)

acts.line: The last full morning of the sailing course on the water off the Croatian coast.
Open sailing with nothing on the calendar, the day yours before you come ashore.
Last night aboard; settle tomorrow's Cavtat transfer while you still have signal.
